name: path_ordering
description: Bytewise path order, not path-component order: '.' (0x2e) < '/' (0x2f) < 'b' (0x62), so 'a' < 'a.b' < 'a/b' < 'ab'. The file 'a' and the directory 'a/' cannot coexist on a filesystem — this fixture pins the digest domain, where the length prefixes keep the two trees distinct.
